scope: Independent standard for ds18b20 on the fixed gpio_timing task configuration, based on its copied reference driver, fixed task requirements, supplied Zephyr API pack and harness. Excludes sample_ref application cadence and device-register behavior.

api_contract.fixed_task_context: GPIO DT specification(s); task requirements name HC-SR04 trig/echo nodes, while DHT22/DS18B20 own refs describe a single data pin

signatures.gpio_pin_configure_dt: int gpio_pin_configure_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, gpio_flags_t flags)
signatures.gpio_pin_set_dt: int gpio_pin_set_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, int value)

handle_and_operations.configuration: GPIO input/output flags and microsecond busy waits

headers: zephyr/kernel.h for timing calls where used
api_contract.return_semantics: Use the integer status from fallible bus/configuration calls; GPIO read yields level or error. UART poll_in is nonblocking: 0 means byte received, nonzero means no byte; poll_out returns void.

facts.requirement: Bind the required gpio_timing handle/configuration on fixed task context: GPIO DT specification(s); task requirements name HC-SR04 trig/echo nodes, while DHT22/DS18B20 own refs describe a single data pin.

Provide the task-required operations with compatible signatures: int gpio_pin_configure_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, gpio_flags_t flags); int gpio_pin_get_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec); int gpio_pin_set_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, int value); void k_busy_wait(uint32_t us); int32_t k_msleep(int32_t duration). Keep handle/address/configuration, buffer and return levels compatible with the reference.
Support reference GPIO configure/set/get operations with microsecond busy-wait timing; DHT22 and DS18B20 also use millisecond sleep in their sensor protocol.
Preserve the fallible API status needed to detect or propagate bus/GPIO configuration and transaction failures; do not convert an error return into success.
